mapper.select: SELECT r.*, a.area_name AS area_name, u1.user_name AS manager_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, ct.cleaning_name AS cleaning_type_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u2.user_name), '') AS staffs_name_str, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name), '') AS tools_name_str, mt.monitor_name AS monitor_type_name, u3.user_name AS monitor_name, mst.monitor_status_name AS monitor_status_name, pt.name AS problem_type_name, u4.user_name AS report_name, d.name AS dept_name, u5.user_name AS handle_name, hs.name AS handle_status_name, tt.name AS task_type_name FROM river r LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON r.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON r.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_cleaning_type ct ON r.cleaning_type_id = ct.cleaning_type_id AND ct.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_monitor_type mt ON r.monitor_type_id = mt.monitor_type_id AND mt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_monitor_status mst ON r.monitor_status_id = mst.monitor_status_id AND mst.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_problem_type pt ON r.problem_type_id = pt.sys_problem_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON r.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON r.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON r.dept_id = d.sys_dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON r.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON r.monitor_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u4 ON r.report_by = u4.user_id AND u4.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u5 ON r.handle_by = u5.user_id AND u5.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON FIND_IN_SET( u2.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_tool t ON FIND_IN_SET( t.sys_tool_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.tool_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, a.area_name, os.name, ct.cleaning_name, mt.monitor_name, mst.monitor_status_name, pt.name, hs.name, d.name, u1.user_name, u3.user_name, u4.user_name, u5.user_name, tt.name ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM river r WHERE r.deleted = 0
